content.text: Overview Salary Job Description Interviews What is a General Manager (GM) ? A General Manager, often referred to as a GM, is a senior executive responsible for the overall operations and performance of a business or organization. This can include areas such as finance, sales, marketing, human resources, and operations. The specific responsibilities of a GM will vary depending on the size and type of organization they are working for. In a large corporation, a GM may be responsible for a specific division or subsidiary, while in a small business they may have overall responsibility for all aspects of the company's operations. The role of a GM is often viewed as a stepping stone to higher level positions within an organization, such as CEO or President. A GM must possess strong leadership skills, as well as the ability to make strategic business decisions. They must also have a thorough understanding of the industry in which they operate, as well as the ability to manage and motivate a team. In order to be successful as a GM, it is important to have a combination of both education and experience. A bachelor's degree in business or a related field is typically required, and many GMs also hold advanced degrees such as an MBA. Additionally, most GMs have several years of experience in management or a related field, with a proven track record of success.
